description: Rijden de Treinen train archive provides an archive of Netherlands train stops, delays, cancellations and timetable changes derived from NS real-time information. The provider is Rijden de Treinen. Geographical and temporal coverage: The provider says all train services since 2019 are stored; each row represents a station stop. The linked provider page supplies the access route and documentation; the resource payload was not retrieved. Licence (read on the provider page on 2026-09-28): CC-BY-4.0. The described material is available without a stated fee. Caveats: Completeness is the provider's claim. For simulation, the documented contents can support transport network modelling and capacity planning. This use is an interpretation of the metadata, not a tested integration. No directly related existing catalogue record was established.
